description: Use this when someone asks whether a battery needs a battery passport or which category it falls into under the EU Battery Regulation, e.g. an e-bike battery or a 3 kWh industrial battery. Classifies a battery under Art. 3 of Regulation (EU) 2023/1542 (LMT, electric vehicle, SLI, portable, industrial) and says whether it needs a battery passport under Art. 77, with the provision. A planning aid, not an official classification. Do not use for general battery deadlines (use list_deadlines) or for the transport of batteries as dangerous goods.

capacity_kwh.description: Capacity in kWh, needed for industrial batteries

for_toy.description: True if the light means of transport is a toy

industrial.description: True if it is designed specifically for industrial use

language.description: Language of the answer: "de" (German, default), "en" (English) or "pl" (Polish). Product and account answers are written in German and English; content without a translation comes in German.

sealed.description: True if the battery is sealed

use.description: lv: light means of transport (e-bike, e-scooter); vehicle: traction battery of a vehicle of category M, N or O; sli: starter battery; other: anything else

name: check_battery_passport
title: Battery category and battery passport
